panels.title: Known peers
panels.description: Peers in the roster, reachable or not.

panels.title: Reachable peers
panels.description: Known peers the node can reach.

panels.title: Used vs quota
panels.description: A gap in the used series means the reading was unavailable.

panels.title: Discarded writes
panels.description: Any band means the node lost a write.

panels.title: Write transaction rate
panels.description: Counts only transactions that opened.

panels.title: Share of committed writes that wrote nothing
Write begin latency (p50/p95/p99)
panels.description: A rising p50 is sustained contention. A flat p50 under a rising p99 is an occasional pile-up.

panels.title: Write execute latency (p50/p95/p99)
panels.description: Time spent inside the transaction.

panels.title: Write commit latency (p50/p95/p99)
panels.description: A rolled-back transaction is absent here.

panels.title: Ring sectors with no accepting peer
Peers accepting remote index, by ring sector
panels.description: The DHT ring unrolled: each row is one sector of the keyspace.

panels.title: Ring fraction from a posting to the peer that accepted its replica (5m p50/p95)
Share of posting offers peers accepted
Lateness of the most overdue posting offer
URL metadata deliveries sent, by outcome
URLs delivered as metadata, by outcome
Replicas dropped from peers
panels.description: A replica the node no longer counts as held by that peer.

panels.title: Postings deleted after closer peers accepted them
Due postings that left the index mid-cycle
URLs a peer asked for that this node does not hold
Share of held postings never claimed
Offered pages, by disposal
panels.description: Each offered page delivery has one terminal disposal. A returned page can produce more than one delivery.

panels.title: Searches answered for peers, by outcome
Ring fraction from this node to requested terms (p50/p95)
Share of time paused for garbage collection
Share of file descriptor capacity used
Delayed writes
panels.description: Any band means the storage engine held writes back and every write waited.

panels.title: Write stalls, by cause
panels.description: What the engine waited for. Memtables awaiting flush means the write buffer filled faster than it drained. L0 files awaiting compaction means compaction fell behind the flushes.

panels.title: Memtable use vs limit
panels.description: Held bytes near the limit with rising memtable count is a write buffer too small for the write rate.

panels.title: Compaction debt
panels.description: Bytes the engine must still compact to settle its shape. A debt that grows and never returns to zero means compaction cannot keep up.

panels.title: Compactions running vs limit
panels.description: Compactions pinned at the limit while debt grows means the engine is allowed too few compactions at once.

panels.title: Block cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of block reads answered from memory. A gap means no reads. Near zero with nothing held means the memtable reserved the whole cache.

panels.title: Block cache use vs limit
panels.description: Held bytes at the limit is the cache running full. Zero held while reads run means the memtable reserved the whole cache.

panels.title: File cache hit ratio and share of open files used
panels.description: Share of table lookups answered from the cache. A gap means no lookups. A falling ratio with the share near one means too few open files.

panels.title: Sublevels, by level
panels.description: A read touches one file per sublevel. The sum over all levels is the read amplification a search pays.

panels.title: Table bytes, by level
panels.description: The shape of the tree. Bytes held at L0 that do not drain to deeper levels precede a stall.

panels.title: Write amplification
panels.description: Bytes compactions rewrote for each byte the memtables flushed in. A high value spends disk throughput on rewriting settled data.

panels.title: Bytes disk holds but reads cannot see
panels.description: Bytes a compaction or a file removal can still return to the disk.

panels.title: Flush and compaction rate
panels.description: What the engine does in the background to settle the tree.

panels.title: Compaction failures
panels.description: Any band means the tree stopped settling and debt will grow.

panels.title: Deleted keys and open snapshots
panels.description: Deleted keys a compaction has not yet removed. A long-lived snapshot keeps them, and the bytes behind them, on disk.
